entries.summary: Argues AI's economic impact is determined by Output = Capability × Speed × Scale, not consciousness or perfection. Intelligence is becoming a utility like electricity. The deeper transformation is coordination compression (reducing matching/planning/bureaucratic friction) rather than simple job automation. Distribution of gains — not capability — is the key risk variable.

claims.claim: AI's coordination compression effect (reducing information asymmetry, planning friction, matching inefficiency, bureaucratic overhead) will be more transformative than direct job automation
When intelligence becomes abundant, scarcity shifts to trust, energy, land, social cohesion, and political stability — these become the new power determinants
White-collar status disruption (thinking no longer guarantees prestige) will be more destabilizing than actual job losses

keyFacts: Output = Capability × Speed × Scale — the core equation for AI economic impact
60% on many professional benchmarks already exceeds median human performance
Businesses tolerate error if cost-adjusted output improves — sufficiency beats perfection
Coordination-heavy tasks (planning, matching, bureaucratic overhead) were bottlenecked by cost, not capability — AI removes the cost barrier
Historical pattern: Industrial Revolution, electrification, internet all restructured work rather than eliminating it — transitions were painful but not permanent collapse

entries.summary: Predicts nine things AI/robotics will destroy in 5-20 years: aging (regenerative medicine), fossil fuels (solar/fusion/nuclear), office work, Hollywood, language barriers (universal translators), traditional education, government jobs (AI + blockchain governance), doctors (AI surpassing in efficiency/accuracy), and social suffering (homelessness, mental illness, poverty). Optimistic framing centered on abundance mindset.

claims.claim: Aging will be effectively ended through regenerative medicine and rejuvenation therapies within 5-20 years
Fossil fuels will be phased out due to advances in solar, fusion, and nuclear power within 5-20 years
Office work and suburbs will decline as AI and automation replace human office roles, reshaping cities
Hollywood/traditional entertainment production will be disrupted by AI-generated content creation
Universal AI translators will effectively eliminate language barriers, enhancing global cultural exchange
AI will surpass human doctors in efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and accuracy, transforming medical practices
Human government roles could be partially replaced by AI and blockchain technology for more efficient and transparent governance
AI-driven personalized education using tools like ChatGPT will replace traditional education models with curiosity-driven learning

keyFacts: OpenAI deep research achieved 27% perplexity improvement
Custom models like Sonar developed for faster search and recall
Nine predicted disruptions: aging, fossil fuels, office work, Hollywood, language barriers, education, government jobs, doctors, social suffering
Recombinant technology: easier to predict what disappears than what's created
